function_to_improve: Oligodendrocyte maturation and myelination (neuron-driven block: precursors up, mature cells down)
why_this_function_wwox_evidence: IT14: neuron-restricted deletion reproduces the deficit, neuronal add-back restores EM counts; maturation block favoured over loss, not demonstrated; one seizure-free co-culture (E09, n=4v4); GSE158684 snRNA: mature-oligodendrocyte-class nuclei about 3-5-fold fewer (pooled, composition not regulation)
candidate_and_form: Tiratricol (Triac; small molecule, approved in some regions for MCT8 deficiency) as TR agonist probe; liothyronine comparator; TR-beta-leaning resmetirom only as isoform control
how_it_arose_and_what_the_engine_execute: Path B (compound-first) in IT21 P3b EXECUTED by the engine path; IT22 added executed typed-potency table (class_alternatives_it22.py) and a partial-text reading of the human Triac papers; the TR-alpha isoform argument is agent reasoning from abstract-level OPC literature, NOT an engine step
why_not_proposed_before: The glia/myelin knowledge (IT14) was in no seed row and no relation table; the compound-first route found it only by analogy to a hormone-uptake defect
knowledge_or_operation_now_used: Cell-population facts now enter as handoff limits and a relation table (p3_B_cellpop), composition is never read as regulation (guard COMPOSITION_NOT_REGULATION, S079 reclassed); potency compared only same-type
works_on_another_case: Same fix (typed comparison + composition guard) changes the EZH2 and NRF2 rows too (PB2, PB3)
novelty_for_legend: new molecule for LEGEND in a known thread (myelination); relation new
evidence_strength: conditional; drug-side precedent read partial text only for Triac trials, abstract for OPC isoform; no WWOX datum on TR signalling
wwox_relevance: moderate: documented maturation pattern, no thyroid-axis datum
feasibility: cell-level probe feasible now; systemic use limited (thyroid-axis suppression at the effective mouse dose; window postnatal weeks 1-3)
possible_opposing_effects: peripheral thyrotoxicosis, axis suppression, seizure worsening in 3 patients with pre-existing seizures (Trial I), hyperthyroid rats more seizure-prone; premature differentiation; TR-alpha cardiac liability
discriminating_experiment: Seizure-free neuron+OPC co-culture, WWOX-deficient vs corrected neurons, hormone-depleted medium, agonist vs vehicle, TR-beta-leaning isoform control; MBP+/CC1+ vs PDGFRa+ counts
result_that_would_close_it: Correction in both genotypes = non-specific maturation; no change = route closed; correction only with the TR-beta-leaning control = isoform premise wrong
